messages:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up 9: routing editor feedback after usability session. Two pain points stood out: (a) when many rules exist the vertical density pushes the preview off-screen, (b) inline error chips cover the sim controls on mobile.

Marcus Hale: Thanks. For density, could we introduce a compact mode toggle that reduces padding & hides secondary meta (created by, last run) so the rule body stays readable? Also consider a sticky header for the preview so controls remain visible.

Ivy Zhou: Compact mode is fine but ensure text legibility. Suggest the compact variant only trims vertical gaps, not font size. For sticky preview header, add a subtle divider and keep the toggle on the right with aria-label including current state.

Carlos Mendez: On validation chips: current behaviour is modal-like overlay attached to the rule. Proposal: convert to inline helper row that expands beneath the rule without overlapping other UI. If space is tight, show a chevron to reveal the helper. That avoids covering sim controls.

accessibility-bot: Accessibility scan summary: 9% of mobile simulated layouts have overlapping interactive regions; compact mode reduces tap target sizes below 44px in 6% of cases. Contrast issues flagged for error chip text at 4.0:1 ratio. Recommendations: maintain 44px min target, bump error text contrast to 4.5:1.

Lena Ortiz: Copy idea for inline helper: "Missing match condition — add at least one condition to evaluate this rule" with a small Fix button that links to the condition editor. Keep language action-oriented.

Marcus Hale: For priority ordering, product asked if we can show a small numeric index in the gutter that updates live as rules move. That'll help non-visual scanning when drag handles collapse. Also add a keyboard-only "move to top/bottom" option in the contextual menu for long lists.

Ivy Zhou: Keyboard accessibility note: if you provide move-to-top/bottom, ensure focus stays on the moved rule and an aria-live announcement like "Rule X moved to position 2 of 12" is fired. Also the collapsed helper should be reachable by keyboard and announced when opened.

Carlos Mendez: Implementation constraints: collapsing metadata must not change DOM order to avoid breaking screen-reader reading order. We'll use CSS to visually hide while keeping elements in DOM flow. Also adding animations could impact perf at large scales; keep them short (<=150ms) and optional via prefers-reduced-motion.

Lena Ortiz: OK action items: Marcus - comp compact mode + gutter index, Ivy - draft aria copy & live announcement phrasing, Carlos - prototype inline helper row that doesn't overlap preview controls, accessibility-bot - re-run checks after changes. Target: ship as part of next UI sprint; review Tuesday. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
